_what: Which kinds of work are risky for YOUR users. The governer uses this as a floor under its score. These are the general defaults; /harness-setup proposes a table built from your own repository and asks you to confirm each row. Until you confirm, every score is marked uncalibrated.

payment.meaning: Anything that charges, refunds, or changes what someone pays.

onboarding.meaning: The first minutes of a new user's experience.

core-feature.meaning: The main thing your product does for people.

cosmetic.meaning: Looks only; nothing changes about what works.

internal-tooling.meaning: Tools only you or your team use.

admin-only.meaning: Admin screens. Raised if what they do reaches users.

docs-only.meaning: Documentation that nothing reads at runtime.

exampleOnly_coreFeatures_from_the_author._label: EXAMPLE ONLY — a sample product list, shipped so you can see what a filled-in table looks like. Not used for scoring.
